_readme: Copy to tracked.local.json (gitignored), then: pnpm track  →  pnpm track --apply
The top-level key is the userId. It MUST match the userId in the
BASIC_AUTH_ACCOUNTS secret, or that person signs in and sees nothing:
a resource you do not own answers 404, not an error.
storefronts x keywords is your whole daily fetch and write volume.
Removing a keyword retires it and keeps its history; it is never deleted.

_comment: Same appId, second language. `language` stamps the keywords AND picks
the locale per storefront, so one entry cannot mix languages. List the
app again to track Spanish terms in the Spanish store — app_language
ends up with both rows, which is exactly right for a bilingual listing.
